trophies.guide: This is the platinum. It unlocks when the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate step to it: work through the roadmap below, and this pops with the last trophy you need.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and finish it. The description names the mission and nothing else, so just follow the mission from start to end and the trophy pops when it completes.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. The trophy is tied to the chapter, not to a single mission, so keep playing the story until the chapter closes and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, this one comes from playing the story through to the end of the chapter.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. The trophy pops when the chapter closes, so there is nothing to do outside the story missions.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and it pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. The description names no mission title, so play the story to its end; the trophy pops when the last mission completes. Do the missable partner trophies before this point, while a partner is still at your side.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. The trophy is for finishing that one mission, so play it through and it pops at the end.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Finish the heist mission itself; the trophy pops when it ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Play the mission to its end and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Finish the mission and the trophy pops at the end of it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. The name points at the airport, Vice City International, but the description only asks for the mission itself, so finish it and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the mission and the trophy pops at the end of it.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game. This is the long one: it counts everything the game tracks toward completion, so finish the story, the stranger strands, the activities and the collectibles first, then check the in-game completion stat for what is left. Do it before the platinum, since the platinum needs it anyway.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the jumps, near misses and airtime moments the game counts as you drive and ride around Leonida, so they build up naturally while you play; a session spent driving fast and jumping ramps moves the count faster. The description gives no list of stunt types, so the count is the only thing to watch.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity in the game at least once. The description does not list the activity types, so open the activities menu in game and work through each one it shows: racing, fishing, shooting range, arcade games, drone races and the rest. One try each is enough.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. The official list tracks 42 Shooting Range challenges, so this is a grind of accuracy and speed across all of them: learn each range layout, then repeat it until the gold time or score lands. Gold in all 42 is the whole ask.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of its locations. The description does not say how many locations there are, so find every Top Fun race on the map, win each one, and the trophy pops after the last location is won.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the key word: the same race won twice counts once, so enter new races across Leonida until 20 distinct wins are on the board. Mix race types if the count stalls.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is a named rival for this one, so find the fishing challenge where he competes and out-fish him. The description names no spot, so follow the fishing activity until the challenge against Cal appears.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Find an arcade machine, play a game on it through to its end, and the trophy pops. Any arcade game counts.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission in Andy's strand. Andy is one of the strangers with a mission strand, so follow his missions until the final one completes. These strands sit outside the main chapters, so they belong in the second stage of the roadmap.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission in Kenton's strand. Follow Kenton's missions until the final one completes and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission in Billy's strand. Follow Billy's missions until the final one completes and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger strands are the side missions given by named characters like Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone; finishing a strand means finishing its final mission. Five of those strands have their own trophies, so this one pops once any 8 strands are done.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission in Randy's strand. Follow Randy's missions until the final one completes and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission in Tyrone's strand. Follow Tyrone's missions until the final one completes and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. The description does not say how many spots there are, so visit each spot the game marks, meditate there, and the trophy pops after the last one. Treat it as a collectible-style sweep of the map.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret asks for one specific animal, so follow his strand until the hunt is offered, then track and take down that animal. The description names no species, so the hunt itself is the guide.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete 3 sets of collectible cards. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so pick up cards as you explore and check which sets are still missing pieces. Three full sets is the target, and the trophy pops when the third set completes.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-game action the description counts, so use it at 100 different spots across Leonida. The description does not list the spots, so use it wherever the prompt appears and keep count until 100.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small tasks the game tracks across activities, so they pile up as you race, shoot, fish and explore. The description sets no type, so any 50 completed challenges count.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. This one is flagged missable because it needs your partner present, and a partner is only at your side during certain story stretches, so do it while the story still pairs you up instead of waiting until after the finale. Lose the wanted level by breaking line of sight and staying out of the search area until it clears.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level. Keep the wanted level alive between robberies: move fast from one shop to the next and do not let the heat drop. Flagged missable for the same reason as Hot Together, it needs your partner, so do it while the story still pairs you up.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Discovering means finding a new vehicle type in the world, so drive, steal and browse your way through Leonida and the count climbs. The description gives no list, so variety is the method: new models, not the same car twice.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Find a fight with at least 5 enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all 5 before it ends. A crowded shootout is the place to try it.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City International airport. The description leaves the method open, so the read is plain: get to the airport and leave in a plane on your own terms, outside a scheduled flight or mission. Any aircraft departure that is not part of a mission should do it.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhinos, the tanks, and it names nothing else. The trophy is tied to the Rhino tank, so get into one and use it until the trophy pops. The description gives no count or place, so the tank itself is the whole condition.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and guards, take the goods, and get out before anyone spots you. Being seen at any point fails the condition, so plan the entry and the exit before you start.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault needs the robbery finished and a clean getaway, so 5 successful runs is the total. The description does not name the banks, so any 5 vault robberies count.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find a truck on the road, stop it, take what it carries, then lose the wanted level it brings. One clean robbery and getaway is enough.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The trophy tracks map coverage, so drive and travel through every region of the state until the map is filled in. The description names no checklist of places, so full coverage is the only target.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Every gang runs operations, so hit one operation per gang until each gang has been robbed. The description does not list the gangs, so work through the ones the game shows you.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The place is named in the description: Ocean Beach. Go there, find a spot serving cocktails, and enjoy one while looking out over the beach.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle through a showroom and out the other side, breaking through as you go. The description asks for the exit by force, so a car and a showroom window are all it takes.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. The place is named in the description, so go to that bowling alley and bowl: the follow-through is the bowling action itself. One visit and a bowled game should do it.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: The description says only that this is about a partnership with mass appeal, with no step named. The honest read is that it comes from a partner activity that draws a crowd, so keep an eye on partner moments and the trophy pops when the right one lands. No location or step is claimed here because the description gives none.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: This trophy is about a choice, and a choice can lock in an outcome, so it is flagged missable: when the game offers a real decision, pick a side and live with it, and the trophy pops on the choice being made. The description names no decision, so the advice is to save before big story choices where the game lets you, and not to rush past a choice prompt.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: The description hints at a second attempt succeeding, so this one is flagged missable: it reads as a one-off event where the second try is the one that counts. When an event in the game offers a retry, take it, and the trophy should pop on the second success. No event is named in the description, so no specific place is claimed here.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: The description is a reaction to something strange, which reads as a secret or one-off event, so it is flagged missable: odd events in open worlds often happen once or in one place, so pay attention to strange encounters as you explore and do not assume they repeat. The description names no event, so no location is claimed here.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. A drive-by with a melee weapon means striking someone from a moving vehicle without a gun, so line up a target, swing from the vehicle as you pass, and the trophy pops on the hit. The bowling name is a joke about knocking them down.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and other illicit income, and your contacts wash them into clean money; keep laundering until $250,000 of it is earned. The total is what counts, so this builds up across the game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop spending counts toward the total, so buy clothes, food, weapons and upgrades as you play and the $100,000 total arrives on its own. It pairs well with the laundering trophy, since clean money is what you spend.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Garages are the properties that store your vehicles, so buy each one the game offers until none are left to buy. The description does not say how many there are, so check property listings as you earn money and buy them as they appear.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is named in the description, so open the Scooter Bros app in game and register vehicles through it until 10 are registered. Any 10 vehicles count.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Official trophy description as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles
